title: Entity link
responsibility: Provides a real explorer link with in-app navigation for plain clicks.

inputs.name: EntityLink.nav
inputs.description: Required functions for constructing the link and navigating within the host.

inputs.name: EntityLink.label
inputs.description: Optional accessible name when visible content is insufficient.

inputs.name: EntityLink.class
inputs.description: Optional CSS class forwarded to the anchor.

inputs.name: EntityLink.title
inputs.description: Optional native hover tooltip, forwarded to the link.

outputs.name: EntityLink
outputs.description: Anchor with a real href. A plain click prevents document navigation and calls nav.go; modified/nonprimary clicks keep native behavior. Does not catch navigation errors.
